sourceTitle: The Manual of the Botany of the Northern United States Including the District East of the Mississippi and North of North Carolina and Tennessee
description: "The Manual of the Botany of the Northern United States" by Asa Gray is a scientific publication likely written in the late 19th century. This manual serves as a comprehensive guide to the flora of the United States, focusing on botanical species found east of the Mississippi River and north of North Carolina and Tennessee.
